body: Saturday near lunch: two workers from the crop plot carried a sharp solvent smell. two hens went still before the lane was closed.
title: Saturday near lunch — a sharp solvent smell
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sharp solvent smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
We were halfway through the same song for the third time when a visitor came in and asked us to lower the volume. He needed to hear the radio in the hallway.

The voice on it was reading street names. One of us lived on the first street and went to call home. The visitor shut the door before the next name.

We tried to play again. Nobody could remember the first line, so I wrote the streets down instead.
title: A rehearsal interrupted
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
